<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **63** of **226** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **163** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **163**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **104** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **12** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json cba7d8ae719f22e80ae7b336e4ee3a15d5c3057b` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `51349289c2a3a4fa112ce027b0befe78983a8f45` — the merge of head `46d96459bc3b57548cc80980a7feab6154c78674` into base `cba7d8ae719f22e80ae7b336e4ee3a15d5c3057b`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 51349289c2a3a4fa112ce027b0befe78983a8f45 && git checkout 51349289c2a3a4fa112ce027b0befe78983a8f45
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin cba7d8ae719f22e80ae7b336e4ee3a15d5c3057b 46d96459bc3b57548cc80980a7feab6154c78674 && git checkout -B drift-repro cba7d8ae719f22e80ae7b336e4ee3a15d5c3057b && git merge --no-ff 46d96459bc3b57548cc80980a7feab6154c78674

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json cba7d8ae719f22e80ae7b336e4ee3a15d5c3057b
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs cba7d8ae719f22e80ae7b336e4ee3a15d5c3057b` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 席位核对 · ACCEPT · 2026-11-08T02:01Z · head `46d96459bc3b57548cc80980a7feab6154c78674`

Seat `domain:server#6` reviewed the diff of its own dispatch (claim 6714774077 on #31272, card thread `session_01FEkQ5nShGw8zYWsUBr1dC3`, report 6715182055). Read against GitHub, not the report.

1. **Shape:** 4 files, +220 / -23. `list_objects`, `describe_object`, `validate_expression` and `list_actions` render a thrown value through the new module-private `metaDoorErrorResult`. It asks `dataDoorAnswerOf(err)` with no object, which is `mapDataError` from `@objectstack/types`, and decides with `isServerFault`. That is the reader the `/meta` doors reach through `handleRouteError`, and nothing of it is copied. A 5xx answers the door's code, sentence and status and is logged once through `logServerFault`. Every other throw keeps `errorResultWithCode`. Body says `Fixes #31272`; no other closing keyword.
2. **Premise:** red first on `main` `7c523aa1`: 14 failed / 102 passed with the new pins and no fix, 116 passed with it. One ablation (`isServerFault` gate forced) went red 14 and was restored to HEAD.
3. **Accepted visible change:** `FIELD_VISIBILITY_UNRESOLVED` / 503 keeps its code and status on the three object-schema tools, and its sentence becomes `Internal server error`, as the `/meta` object read already answers (#5437). The existing pins on it assert code and status only and stay green. The runtime docblock on `fieldVisibilityRefusal` is outside the file surface and was left alone, which is right for this card.
4. **Merge-forward:** PR #31300 merged first, so the head moved `5838a614` → `46d96459`, a merge commit of `origin/main` `f8c3ecc4` with no rebase. The one conflict was the `dataDoorAnswerOf` signature line, kept as `export function dataDoorAnswerOf(err: unknown, objectName?: string)` (#31300's `export`, this PR's optional `objectName`). I compared the own diff against the new merge base line by line with the diff `7c523aa1..5838a614`. The only difference is that one line, from `function` to `export function`, which came from `main`. The PR body's "the function is not exported" now reads "not exported from the package entry": `src/index.ts` re-exports `mcp-http-tools.ts` by name and does not list it, so nothing published moves.
5. **Gates / check-runs:** 48 runs on `46d96459`, 35 success, 13 skipped, 0 red. `mergeable_state` clean. Dev on the new head: mcp 60/60 files (840 tests), typecheck exit 0, 65/65 derived gates exit 0 (`check:lean-entry-closure` first exited 3 on a missing objectql dist and exited 0 after the full build), `--ran` 65/65 with 0 NOT-MEASURED.
6. **Contract review:** `Clause-②: no` (no type, member or package export changes; a fault answer becomes the one `/meta` already gives in members the tool error already declares), no `packages/spec/src` path: none owed.
7. **Out of scope:** the code-less sandboxed abort on these four faces still renders the wrapper text where `/meta` answers `400 HOOK_ABORTED`. No production producer reaches these members with it, and a CONTROL row pins it. Nothing filed. `Metadata-protocol: none`; `Skills-docs:` not owed.
8. **Landing:** `check-governed-merges --pr 31310`: not governed, 243 changed lines. Changeset patch for `@objectstack/mcp`. Landing on the maintainer's standing words 「按照 pm-dispatch 规则复核过的都授权」 (2026-10-25T11:35Z) and 「你应该使用 pm-dispatch 技能审核和落地pr」 (2026-11-07T16:59Z). Relay `pr_ready`, then `automerge_enable`.
